abstract_title: Geometric Vitalism: A Structural Refinement of Dual-Aspect Theory
abstract: # Geometric Vitalism: A Structural Refinement of Dual-Aspect Theory ## Abstract Geometric Vitalism (GV) refines dual-aspect theory by giving operational structure to what that tradition usually treats metaphorically. Rather than attempting a full metaphysical account of reality, GV focuses on how experience arises at a locus where two irreducible structural dimensions in a conceptual coordinate space—physicality and consciousness—jointly specify an experiential center.
